metadata.description: social-flow marketplace — installs the channel-based short-form and long-form content pipeline plugin (built-in MCP server included).

plugins.name: social-flow
plugins.description: Plan, produce, review, and publish channel-based social videos. Storyboard plans dialogue and stops for approval; produce builds approved episodes; autoproduce runs both unattended. Includes reusable characters, voice settings, media generation, research, and publishing tools in one bundled MCP server.
